function invalidGenericKey<K extends 'x' | 'y'>(key: K, object: {x: number}) {
  const {[key]: value} = object;
  return value;
}
function invalidConcreteKey(key: 'x' | 'y', object: {x: number}) {
  const {[key]: value} = object;
  return value;
}
function invalidPropertyKey<K>(key: K, object: {x: number}) {
  const {[key]: value} = object;
  return value;
}
function invalidBooleanKey<K extends true>(key: K, object: {x: number}) {
  const {[key]: value} = object;
  return value;
}
function invalidElementAccess<K extends 'x' | 'y'>(key: K, object: {x: number}) {
  return object[key];
}
